content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Resubmission would not correct the authorization defect, while a formal appeal is permitted with the denial on file and is the only available payer action with demonstrated success on similar claims (6/18 paid). Therefore, submit a medical-necessity appeal before considering downstream patient responsibility or write-off.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
